verification.notes: Transcript context attributes the vendor meeting and communications to Candace Owens without naming documentary evidence. Live searches found the allegation repeated in commentary and confirmed Marcus Wada holds a TPUSA production role, but no statement from VFX Los Angeles, TPUSA, Wada, meeting record, or other independent evidence established the contact. No conclusive source was found.

records.text: Candace Owens cited VFXLA's website as saying it could clone a specific voice and had recreated the voice of deceased baseball commentator Skip Caray.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: A specific voice, voice cloning. Using a bespoke AI model for that exact voice, there is no accent or colloquialism that we cannot generate. Case in point, this project for Fanatics Collectible, where we had to reproduce the unique timber and intonation of the deceased baseball commentator Skip Caray.

verification.notes: The current VFX Los Angeles site explicitly advertises recreation of a specific voice through a bespoke AI model and presents the Fanatics Collectibles project reproducing the voice of deceased baseball commentator Skip Caray. This directly matches the cited website description.
